fixes.explanation: Nice try, friend, but nobody gets turned back into wood here. “But Aaron’s staff swallowed up the other staffs.” (Exodus 7:12) Every magician threw down a staff, and it became a serpent. Then Aaron’s staff swallowed up the rest. I think those magicians were doing some quick math about how their morning was going.

That’s it, baker. “So all the Egyptians dug around the Nile for water to drink, because they could not drink the water from the river.” ALL of them, digging, staring at the ground like it owes them something. I think that's what it looks like when nobody has a backup plan.

Rainwater isn't in the text, friend. It says the Egyptians dug around the Nile for water to drink, because they could not drink the water from the river (Exodus 7:24). No jars lined up, no clouds mentioned. I'd have grabbed a jar and hoped too, but this verse has digging, not weather.

problems.problem: The text does not say the magicians held up their serpents proudly or that Aaron’s serpent went down a line. It says they threw down their staffs and Aaron’s staff swallowed the others.
The text says the Egyptians dug around the Nile, but it does not say they used shovels.
The explanation says the verse has shovels, but it does not mention what the Egyptians used to dig.
